newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Power firms amid heavy buying.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Power firms amid heavy buying.

text.p: Shares in Scottish Power Plc firmed on Wednesday as some large orders squeezed the stock higher, dealers said.
The shares were 22p higher at 469 by 1343 GMT. Volume, at 33.5 million, was the second highest of the day on London's stock exchange, behind British Telecom.
Dealers said the bulk of the volume in Scottish Power had come from a few large deals of several million shares.
"We've had a handful of pretty big orders today and that squeezed the shares higher," one market-maker said.
